assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_01_th.title: The Gladiator (Yearning)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_01_th.speaker: Act I · Koren (Valen's Father)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_01_th.overview: Under the merciless glare of Highcrown's coliseum sun, the scarred gladiator Koren—Valen's true father long before the prince ever knew his bloodline—drags himself across crimson sand after shattering another rival's helm for King Garrick's sport. Choking on yellow arena dust, Koren lifts his bruised eyes to the high royal balcony where Queen Ellowyn watches in silent anguish, two prisoners yearning across stone and iron.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_01_th.worldHistory: Every verse of this opening ballad belongs to the secret tragedy behind your campaign: before Valen was born, his father Koren fought in chains under Highcrown's arena while Queen Ellowyn endured King Garrick's loveless throne.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_02_th.title: The Queen (The Plan)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_02_th.speaker: Act I · Queen Ellowyn (Valen's Mother)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_02_th.overview: High in her cold stone gallery overlooking the empty, bloodstained coliseum, Queen Ellowyn—Valen's mother—paces behind gilded doors, bound in a bitter marriage to King Garrick while her heart belongs to the gladiator Koren below. When border war horns force Garrick out of Highcrown with his host, Ellowyn's loyal handmaid secretly weaves a forged chisel key and letter inside Koren's bandages so the two may meet.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_02_th.worldHistory: Crownlands singers recall how King Garrick's endless border wars finally pulled his iron guard out of the capital, giving Ellowyn and Koren one fleeting chance to escape their cages together.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_03_th.title: The Gladiator (The Affair)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_03_th.speaker: Act I · Koren & Queen Ellowyn
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_03_th.overview: At midnight while the castle sleeps, Koren—Valen's father—pries loose his cell's drainage grate and crawls upward through dust-choked dry aqueducts beneath Highcrown's walls. Stepping out into the moonlit overgrown garden ruins, Koren meets Queen Ellowyn in secret, sharing brief sanctuary together and splitting an interlocking silver wolf pendant between them.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_03_th.worldHistory: To this day, travelers passing Highcrown's ruined gardens walk above those very dry aqueduct tunnels where Koren crawled to reach Ellowyn—the origin of the divided silver wolf pendant hanging at the heart of Valen's past.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_04_th.title: The Queen (The Seduction)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_04_th.speaker: Act I · Queen Ellowyn's Secret
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_04_th.overview: Frozen under graying dawn mist in the garden ruins as King Garrick's returning war horns blow across the ridge, Queen Ellowyn tells Koren the devastating truth: she carries his unborn child—Valen. To keep their child and Koren alive, Koren drops back down the aqueduct grate while Ellowyn scrubs garden soil from her skin, dons her silver crown, and deceives Garrick into raising Koren's son as his royal heir.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_04_th.worldHistory: Only Ellowyn and her handmaid knew the truth kept hidden behind Highcrown's dawn gates: that the heir raised beneath King Garrick's wolf banner was born of Koren's blood and Ellowyn's quiet sacrifice.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_05_th.title: The King (The Iron Heir)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_05_th.speaker: Act II · King Garrick, Koren & Young Valen
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_05_th.overview: Twelve winters into his reign, King Garrick watches twelve-year-old Prince Valen in the training yard—oblivious that the boy is Koren's biological son—and decides military captains are too soft to forge a ruthless ruler. Garrick summons Koren, still the deadliest gladiator in the pit, and offers him his freedom in exchange for personally training Valen to fight and kill.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_05_th.worldHistory: Veteran soldiers still recount the bitter irony of Garrick's decree: forcing an enslaved father to hammer lethal steel discipline into his own unsuspecting son in the open yard.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_06_th.title: The Prince (The Arrogant Pupil)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_06_th.speaker: Act II · Young Prince Valen & Koren
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_06_th.overview: Under scorching midday sun, arrogant twelve-year-old Prince Valen crashes repeatedly into the gravel beneath Koren's wooden sword, seething with hatred at being ordered around by a lowborn gladiator—never knowing his harsh teacher is his real father. Clenching the secret half of the silver wolf pendant his mother pressed into his hand, Valen vows to master every strike Koren teaches until he can crush him.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_06_th.worldHistory: Weald minstrels sing this verse with aching pity: the very silver half-pendant giving young Valen strength in the courtyard matched the hidden chain worn by the father drilling him through the dirt.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_07_th.title: The Lead Commander (Whispers & The Scar)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_07_th.speaker: Act II · Commander Orin Sees the Truth
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_07_th.overview: Five years later as seventeen-year-old Valen strikes targets with cruel precision, Commander Orin catches sight of the jagged half-pendant on the prince's chest from the ramparts—instantly recognizing its matching half hidden in Koren's cell and realizing Queen Ellowyn's secret. Moments later in the yard below, humiliating himself in a reckless lunge before King Garrick, Valen takes Koren's counter-slash across his cheek, carving a lifelong scar and vow of vengeance.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_07_th.worldHistory: Across Crownlands ramparts, soldiers remember Orin's quiet vigilance—and know the horizontal scar across Valen's face came from his own father's reluctant blade during a reckless sparring bout.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_08_th.title: The Prince (The Humiliation)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_08_th.speaker: Act II · Valen's Fatal Challenge
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_08_th.overview: Ordered by King Garrick to publicly read Koren's decree of freedom at the packed coliseum games, an older scarred Valen marches onto the sands while Queen Ellowyn fights back silent relief—caught sharply by Commander Orin. Standing face-to-face with the veteran gladiator who scarred his face, Valen lets pride ignite: he rips his father's freedom scroll in two and demands a duel to the death.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_08_th.worldHistory: Highcrown merchants and guards still remember the stunned silence over the coliseum the day Prince Valen shredded Koren's freedom parchment—condemning his own unknowing father before a roaring crowd.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_09_th.title: The Gladiator (The Sacrifice)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_09_th.speaker: Act III · Koren's Fatherly Sacrifice
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_09_th.overview: Horrified as Valen tears up his freedom and unleashes a furious storm of lethal strikes, Koren swears inwardly never to harm his own flesh and blood. Fighting purely on defense through blinding dust until no escape remains, Koren drops his shield on purpose, bares his unguarded side, and lets his own son drive steel straight through his heart—leaving his hidden silver half-pendant to spill onto the sand.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_09_th.worldHistory: Even rough harbor sailors lower their mugs when these chords begin—honoring Koren, the father who laid down his shield and gave his life rather than spill his own son's blood.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_10_th.title: The Prince (The Awakening)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_10_th.speaker: Act III · Valen Learns He Slew His Father
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_10_th.overview: Believing he has finally proved his honor as Koren's guard falls low, Valen plunges his sword deep into his teacher's chest—only to spot a familiar flash of silver beneath Koren's shifted armor. Dropping to his knees in panic, Valen presses his own hidden chain against Koren's in the dust; the two halves snap seamlessly into one wolf pendant as Queen Ellowyn's weeping horror confirms the truth—Valen just killed his own biological father.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_10_th.worldHistory: Beside winter hearths throughout Ethoria, this ballad falls to a solemn whisper: the shattering moment Prince Valen's arrogance died in the arena sand, beginning the grief and mourning he carries for the father he unwittingly forced to the death.

assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_11_th.title: The King (The Wrath of the Crown)
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_11_th.shortTitle: Ballad XI · Wrath of the Crown
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_11_th.speaker: Act III · King Garrick's Wrath & Your Beginning
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_11_th.overview: Frozen silence turns to tempest as King Garrick gazes down at the joined silver pendant in the sand and Ellowyn's terrified tears, realizing his prized heir carries Koren's blood. Roaring in fury, Garrick tears the crown from Queen Ellowyn's head, locks her away in the deepest castle vault, strips Valen of honor and title, and throws his mourning stepson into Koren's own pitch-black cell before marching north to unleash dark war.
assets/audio/music/taverns/chapter_11_th.worldHistory: Here the taverns' ballads end right where your journey opens: thrown into his dead father's dark cell, broken and grieving, Valen forged the oath to rescue his mother Queen Ellowyn, seal Garrick's Portals, and redeem his father's name.
